message.reasoning:
We need to produce test cases for exception scenarios not covered. Analyze method min(Indicator<Num>) implementation: it returns NumericIndicator.of(BinaryOperation.min(this, other)). Likely BinaryOperation.min checks for null arguments and maybe same series length? Need to infer possible exceptions: NullPointerException if other is null. IllegalArgumentException if other is of different BarSeries length? In TA4J, Indicator expects same BarSeries; maybe BinaryOperation checks that both indicators have same BarSeries; if not, may throw IllegalArgumentException. Also, if other is not an Indicator<Num> (type mismatch) but compile-time ensures. So exception scenarios: passing null, passing indicator with different BarSeries (different series length). Also maybe passing indicator that throws exception on getValue (e.g., index out of bounds). But min method itself likely only checks null.

Thus create test cases group: NumericIndicator.min(Indicator<Num>) exception scenarios.

Cases:
1. other == null => NullPointerException.
2. other belongs to a different BarSeries (different series) => IllegalArgumentException (or IllegalStateException). Need to check actual library; but we assume IllegalArgumentException.

3. other indicator that has fewer bars than this indicator (shorter series) causing IndexOutOfBoundsException when min tries to access index beyond its length. But BinaryOperation may handle by using getBarSeries() of first indicator; still may cause out-of-bounds later. We can test by calling getValue on resulting indicator at index beyond other length; expecting IndexOutOfBoundsException.

Thus design test cases.

Structure JSON array with groups.

Group name: "NumericIndicator.min(Indicator<Num>) exception handling".

Cases list.

Each case includes input param: other value description.

We need to specify values: For null: value null.

For different series: create new BarSeries with different data and ConstantIndicator based on that series.

For shorter series: create other indicator based on series with fewer bars.

Expected exception: NullPointerException, IllegalArgumentException, IndexOutOfBoundsException.

Description accordingly.

Return JSON.
